title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy mandates, media messaging, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask usage among their social contacts; perceived social norm and peer pressure update their adoption propensity.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_location
interactions.description: Locations with mask requirements and enforcement levels influence compliance; non-compliance may incur penalties or denial of service.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Media outlets broadcast messages (pro-mask or misinformation) that update individuals' beliefs and perceived benefits/costs.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to inventory and price; successful purchase affects ability to adopt.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Changes in epidemic context (e.g., rising case rates) modify public risk signal and individuals' risk perception, affecting adoption decisions.

interactions.name: social_norm_feedback
interactions.description: Population-level adoption feeds back into perceived norms, further influencing individual adoption propensity.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption level reached and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 60%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration
metrics.description: Number of consecutive days adoption stays above a chosen threshold.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption levels segmented by subgroup (age, income, political identity) to assess equity.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to mandate or campaign (e.g., difference-in-differences pre/post policy).

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals complying with mask requirements when mandate is active.

metrics.name: information_balance_index
metrics.description: Share of population exposed to pro-mask messages minus share exposed to misinformation.

metrics.name: supply_shortfall_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of days where demand exceeds available mask supply.

metrics.name: social_contagion_coefficient
metrics.description: Estimated effect of peer adoption on individual adoption probability (e.g., regression coefficient).

metrics.name: fit_rmse
metrics.description: RMSE between simulated and observed adoption (if empirical data is provided for calibration).

validation_criteria.name: stability_across_runs
validation_criteria.description: Across multiple seeds, key metrics (e.g., overall_adoption_rate) vary within acceptable bounds (e.g., coefficient of variation < 0.1).

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_dynamics
validation_criteria.description: Adoption trajectory approaches a steady state or stable cycle (e.g., |delta adoption| < 0.005 over 14 consecutive days) in scenarios without shocks.

validation_criteria.name: mass_balance
validation_criteria.description: Population counts and inventory are conserved (no negative counts or creation of agents/items).

validation_criteria.name: policy_sanity_checks
validation_criteria.description: With zero enforcement and no campaigns, adoption should not exceed initial levels by more than a small drift; with strong mandate and supply, adoption should increase materially.
